meanings.explanation: An [appetizer] is a small dish of food that you eat before the main part of a meal.

examples.english: I ordered an [appetizer] of soup before my pizza.
examples.chinese: 我在比萨之前点了一份汤做[开胃菜]。

examples.english: Mom made some [appetizers] for the party before dinner.
examples.chinese: 妈妈为派对准备了一些晚餐前的[开胃小吃]。

examples.english: We shared a cheese [appetizer] at the restaurant.
examples.chinese: 我们在餐厅一起分享了一份奶酪[开胃菜]。

meanings.explanation: [Art] is the activity of creating drawings, paintings, or sculptures that are beautiful or express feelings and ideas.

examples.english: I love [art] because I can draw my favorite animals.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢[美术]，因为我可以画我最喜欢的动物。

examples.english: We used colorful paper to make [art] in class today.
examples.chinese: 今天我们上课用彩纸做了[手工]。

examples.english: Mom hung my [art] on the wall for everyone to see.
examples.chinese: 妈妈把我的[画]挂在墙上给大家看。

meanings.explanation: An [amphibian] is a cold-blooded animal that lives both in water and on land, such as a frog, toad, or salamander.

examples.english: A frog is an [amphibian] that starts its life in the water.
examples.chinese: 青蛙是一种[两栖动物]，它在水里开始生命。

examples.english: We saw a small [amphibian] hop from the pond into the grass.
examples.chinese: 我们看到一只小[两栖动物]从池塘跳进了草丛里。

examples.english: Many [amphibians] like salamanders live under wet rocks near rivers.
examples.chinese: 很多[两栖动物]，比如蝾螈，住在河边潮湿的石头下面。

meanings.explanation: [Antiquity] means the very ancient past, especially the time of ancient Greece and Rome, long before we were born.

examples.english: In [antiquity], people used candles instead of electric lights.
examples.chinese: 在[古代]，人们用蜡烛而不是电灯。

examples.english: We learned about life in [antiquity] in our history class today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在历史课上学习了[古代]的生活。

examples.english: The old museum has many beautiful things from [antiquity].
examples.chinese: 这座老博物馆有很多来自[古代]的精美文物。

meanings.explanation: [Anthropology] is the scientific study of human beings, their societies, cultures, and how people have developed over time.

examples.english: My uncle teaches [anthropology] at a university.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔在大学里教[人类学]。

examples.english: I read a fun book about [anthropology] last week.
examples.chinese: 我上周读了一本关于[人类学]的有趣的书。

examples.english: [Anthropology] helps us learn how different people around the world live.
examples.chinese: [人类学]帮助我们了解世界各地不同人群的生活方式。

meanings.explanation: An [adaptation] is a special change in a living thing that helps it live and survive in its environment.

examples.english: A camel's hump is an [adaptation] that helps it live in the hot desert.
examples.chinese: 驼峰是骆驼适应沙漠生活的[特征]。

examples.english: The polar bear's thick fur is an [adaptation] for keeping warm in the snow.
examples.chinese: 北极熊厚厚的皮毛是在雪地里保暖的[适应特征]。

examples.english: Some plants have [adaptations] that help them store water for a long time.
examples.chinese: 有些植物拥有长期储水的[适应能力]。

meanings.explanation: [DNA] is the chemical substance in the cells of living things that carries genetic information passed from parents to their children.

examples.english: Your [DNA] comes from your father and mother.
examples.chinese: 你的[脱氧核糖核酸]来自你的爸爸妈妈。

examples.english: Every person has their own unique [DNA].
examples.chinese: 每个人都有独一无二的[脱氧核糖核酸]。

examples.english: A [DNA] test can help find out if people are related.
examples.chinese: [脱氧核糖核酸]检测可以帮助确认人们是否有亲属关系。

meanings.explanation: A [balcony] is a small platform outside a window on an upper floor of a building, where people can stand or sit.

examples.english: We sat on the [balcony] and watched the sunset.
examples.chinese: 我们坐在[阳台]上看日落。

examples.english: The hotel room has a small [balcony] with a beautiful view.
examples.chinese: 酒店房间有一个小[阳台]，风景很美。

examples.english: Mom is watering the flowers on the [balcony].
examples.chinese: 妈妈正在[阳台]上浇花。

meanings.explanation: An [aurora] is a beautiful display of colorful lights in the night sky, seen near the North and South Poles.

examples.english: Last night, we saw the beautiful [aurora] in the sky.
examples.chinese: 昨晚我们在天空中看到了美丽的[极光]。

examples.english: The [aurora] lights up the night sky with green, pink, and purple colors.
examples.chinese: [极光]用绿色、粉色和紫色照亮了夜空。

examples.english: My family went to Norway to see the [aurora].
examples.chinese: 我们家去挪威看了[极光]。

meanings.explanation: [Archaeology] is the study of ancient peoples and past civilizations by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

examples.english: My father studies [archaeology] and digs for old things underground.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸研究[考古学]，在地下挖掘古老的器物。

examples.english: We learned about [archaeology] during our school trip to the museum.
examples.chinese: 我们在博物馆研学旅行中了解了[考古学]。

examples.english: Many new facts about the past are discovered through [archaeology].
examples.chinese: 很多关于过去的新事实都是通过[考古学]发现的。

meanings.explanation: A [barista] is a person who makes and serves coffee and other drinks in a coffee shop or café.

examples.english: The [barista] made me a warm hot chocolate today.
examples.chinese: 今天那位[咖啡师]给我做了一杯热乎的热巧克力。

examples.english: My cousin wants to be a [barista] when she grows up.
examples.chinese: 我表姐长大后想当一名[咖啡师]。

examples.english: The nice [barista] gave me a little candy with my drink.
examples.chinese: 这位友善的[咖啡师]给我的饮品送了一颗小糖果。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [abstract] is an idea or a feeling that you cannot see or touch with your hands.

examples.english: Love is an [abstract] idea because you cannot touch it.
examples.chinese: 爱是一种[抽象的]概念，因为你摸不到它。

examples.english: My sister likes to paint [abstract] pictures with lots of bright colors.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐喜欢用很多亮丽的颜色画[抽象的]画。

examples.english: Happiness is a kind of [abstract] feeling inside your heart.
examples.chinese: 快乐是心里的一种[抽象的]感觉。

meanings.explanation: A [beverage] is any kind of drink that people can have, such as water, juice, milk, tea, or soda.

examples.english: What is your favorite [beverage] at lunchtime?
examples.chinese: 你午餐时最喜欢喝什么[饮料]？

examples.english: Mom bought many [beverages] for my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 妈妈为我的生日派对买了很多[饮料]。

examples.english: I like to drink a warm [beverage] in the morning.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢早上喝一杯热[饮料]。

meanings.explanation: An [asteroid] is a large rock that floats in space, especially one that moves around the Sun.

examples.english: Scientists found a new [asteroid] near Mars.
examples.chinese: 科学家在火星附近发现了一颗新的[小行星]。

examples.english: Many [asteroids] are located between Mars and Jupiter.
examples.chinese: 很多[小行星]位于火星和木星之间。

examples.english: If a big [asteroid] hits Earth, it can be very dangerous.
examples.chinese: 如果一颗大的[小行星]撞击地球，会非常危险。

meanings.explanation: [Biodiversity] is the variety of all the different kinds of plants, animals, and other living things that exist in one area or on the whole Earth.

examples.english: The rainforest has amazing [biodiversity] with thousands of different plants and animals.
examples.chinese: 热带雨林拥有惊人的[生物多样性]，那里有成千上万种不同的动植物。

examples.english: We should protect [biodiversity] so that all living things can have a safe home.
examples.chinese: 我们应该保护[生物多样性]，让所有生物都有一个安全的家园。

examples.english: The ocean is full of [biodiversity], from tiny fish to huge whales.
examples.chinese: 海洋里充满了[生物多样性]，从小鱼到巨大的鲸鱼都有。

common_collocations: the start of the academic year
the end of the academic year

meanings.explanation: An [academic year] is the period of time each year when students go to school, usually starting in autumn and ending in summer.

examples.english: The [academic year] starts in September and ends in June.
examples.chinese: [学年]从九月开始，到六月结束。

examples.english: We have a long summer holiday at the end of the [academic year].
examples.chinese: [学年]结束时我们有一个长长的暑假。

examples.english: My sister will start a new [academic year] at a different school.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐将在另一所学校开始新的[学年]。

meanings.explanation: A [blueprint] is a special drawing or plan that shows exactly how to build something, like a house or a toy.

examples.english: The architect drew a [blueprint] of the new school.
examples.chinese: 建筑师画了一张新学校的[蓝图]。

examples.english: My dad showed me the [blueprint] before we built our treehouse.
examples.chinese: 爸爸在建造我们的树屋前给我看了[蓝图]。

examples.english: We looked at the [blueprint] to find where the windows should go.
examples.chinese: 我们看了看[蓝图]，找到窗户应该放在哪里。

meanings.explanation: A [celebrity] is a person who is very famous, especially in areas such as movies, music, or sports, and is known to many people.

examples.english: My favorite [celebrity] is the singer who won the music award last year.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的[明星]是去年获得音乐奖项的那位歌手。

examples.english: Many kids dream of becoming a [celebrity] when they grow up.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子长大后都想成为[名人]。

examples.english: The [celebrity] waved to her fans and signed autographs.
examples.chinese: 那位[名人]向粉丝们挥手并签了名。

meanings.explanation: A [cell] is the smallest living part of a living thing. All animals and plants are made of many tiny cells.

examples.english: Our body is made of millions of tiny [cells].
examples.chinese: 我们的身体是由无数微小的[细胞]构成的。

examples.english: A plant [cell] has a strong wall around it.
examples.chinese: 植物[细胞]外面有一层坚硬的壁。

examples.english: Scientists use a microscope to look at a single [cell].
examples.chinese: 科学家用显微镜来观察单个[细胞]。

meanings.explanation: A [buffet] is a meal where people serve themselves from a range of different dishes laid out on a table.

examples.english: We ate at a breakfast [buffet] during our hotel vacation.
examples.chinese: 我们住酒店度假的时候吃了早餐[自助餐]。

examples.english: I love picking all my favorite foods from the [buffet].
examples.chinese: 我最爱从[自助餐]里挑我所有喜欢的食物。

examples.english: My school party had a [buffet] with lots of different sandwiches and fruit.
examples.chinese: 我们学校派对准备了有很多三明治和水果的[自助餐]。

meanings.explanation: A [championship] is a competition or series of games in which players or teams compete to become the best and win a prize.

examples.english: Our school basketball team won the [championship] last year.
examples.chinese: 我们学校篮球队去年赢得了[冠军]。

examples.english: She trained very hard for the swimming [championship].
examples.chinese: 她为了游泳[锦标赛]非常努力地训练。

examples.english: The whole town celebrated when their team took the [championship].
examples.chinese: 当他们的队伍夺得[冠军]时，整个小镇都庆祝了起来。

meanings.explanation: A [comedian] is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling funny stories or jokes.

examples.english: The [comedian] told a funny joke and everyone laughed.
examples.chinese: 那位[喜剧演员]讲了个好笑的笑话，大家都笑了。

examples.english: My dream is to become a [comedian] when I grow up.
examples.chinese: 我的梦想是长大后成为一名[喜剧演员]。

examples.english: We watched a [comedian] on TV last night and had a great time.
examples.chinese: 昨晚我们在电视上看了一位[喜剧演员]的表演，开心极了。

meanings.explanation: A [cache] is a safe, hidden place where someone keeps a collection of things, like food, toys, or treasures, so they can use them later.

examples.english: The squirrel hides nuts in a [cache] under the tree for winter.
examples.chinese: 松鼠在树下藏了[一堆]坚果，留着冬天吃。

examples.english: We found a [cache] of old toy cars in the garage.
examples.chinese: 我们在车库里发现了[一箱]旧玩具车。

examples.english: The pirate left a [cache] of gold coins on the island.
examples.chinese: 海盗在岛上留下了一[批]金币。

meanings.explanation: A [civilization] is a society that has its own culture, language, and way of living together.

examples.english: Ancient Egypt was a great [civilization].
examples.chinese: 古埃及是一个伟大的[文明]。

examples.english: Chinese [civilization] has a very long history.
examples.chinese: 中国[文明]有着非常悠久的历史。

examples.english: We should learn about different [civilizations] in the world.
examples.chinese: 我们应该了解世界上不同的[文明]。

meanings.explanation: [Colonization] is when people from one country travel to a new place and begin living there, often taking control of the land and making rules for it.

examples.english: We read a book about the [colonization] of a faraway island.
examples.chinese: 我们读了一本关于遥远小岛被[殖民]的书。

examples.english: The [colonization] of new lands changed the world in many ways.
examples.chinese: 新土地的[殖民]在很多方面改变了世界。

examples.english: Our teacher explained what [colonization] means in simple words.
examples.chinese: 老师用简单的话解释了[殖民]是什么意思。

meanings.explanation: A [condiment] is something you put on food, like ketchup, mustard, or salt, to make it taste better.

examples.english: I put ketchup, my favorite [condiment], on my french fries.
examples.chinese: 我把最喜欢的[调味酱]番茄酱涂在薯条上。

examples.english: Can you please pass the [condiment] so I can add some mustard to my hot dog?
examples.chinese: 请把[调料]递给我好吗？我想给热狗加点芥末。

examples.english: Salt is a very common [condiment] that people use every day when they cook.
examples.chinese: 盐是一种非常常见的[调味品]，人们每天做饭都会用到。

meanings.explanation: A [column] is a tall, upright, round post that helps support a building or stands alone as a decoration.

examples.english: The old temple has many tall stone [columns].
examples.chinese: 那座古庙有许多高大的石[柱]。

examples.english: We sat behind a big [column] and couldn't see the stage.
examples.chinese: 我们坐在一根大[柱子]后面，看不到舞台。

examples.english: The museum entrance has four white marble [columns].
examples.chinese: 博物馆入口处有四根白色大理石[柱子]。

meanings.explanation: A [chorus] is a group of people who sing together for public performances or events.

examples.english: Our school [chorus] practiced for the school show every week.
examples.chinese: 我们学校的[合唱团]每周都为校园演出排练。

examples.english: The [chorus] sang a happy song for all the parents.
examples.chinese: [合唱团]为所有家长唱了一首欢快的歌。

examples.english: I love listening to the church [chorus] sing on Sundays.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢周日听教堂[唱诗班]唱歌。

meanings.explanation: A [comet] is a bright icy object in space that moves around the sun, with a long bright tail that can sometimes be seen from Earth.

examples.english: Last night, I saw a bright [comet] in the night sky with my dad.
examples.chinese: 昨晚，我和爸爸在夜空中看到了一颗明亮的[彗星]。

examples.english: Our science teacher taught us that a [comet] has a long glowing tail.
examples.chinese: 我们的科学老师告诉我们，[彗星]有一条长长的发光尾巴。

examples.english: I built a model of a [comet] for my school's science fair.
examples.chinese: 我为学校的科学展做了一个[彗星]模型。

meanings.explanation: A [cultural relic] is an old object made by people long ago that teaches us about history and ancient cultures.

examples.english: This [cultural relic] was made over two thousand years ago.
examples.chinese: 这件[文物]是两千多年前制成的。

examples.english: The museum has many [cultural relics] from the Tang dynasty.
examples.chinese: 博物馆里有许多唐代的[文物]。

examples.english: We should protect every [cultural relic] so future generations can see it.
examples.chinese: 我们应该保护每一件[文物]，让后代也能看到它。

meanings.explanation: A [cuisine] is a style of cooking that is typical of a particular country or region.

examples.english: Chinese [cuisine] has many delicious dishes.
examples.chinese: 中国[菜系]有很多好吃的菜。

examples.english: My mom cooks Italian [cuisine] every Friday.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈每个星期五都会做意大利[菜系]的菜。

examples.english: I love trying different kinds of [cuisine].
examples.chinese: 我喜欢品尝不同种类的[菜系]。

meanings.explanation: A [curriculum] is the set of subjects and lessons that students study at a school or in a course.

examples.english: Our school [curriculum] includes English, math, science, and art.
examples.chinese: 我们学校的[课程]包括英语、数学、科学和美术。

examples.english: The teachers worked together to improve the reading [curriculum] this year.
examples.chinese: 老师们一起努力改进了今年的阅读[课程]。

examples.english: Following the school [curriculum] helps students learn everything they need.
examples.chinese: 按照学校的[课程]学习能帮学生掌握所有需要的内容。

meanings.explanation: [Communism] is a system in which a country tries to make sure that everyone has the same amount of things they need, like food and homes.

examples.english: We learned about [communism] in history class today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在历史课上学习了[共产主义]。

examples.english: Our teacher said [communism] is a way some countries organize their society.
examples.chinese: 老师说[共产主义]是一些国家组织社会的方式。

examples.english: The book explains what [communism] means in simple words.
examples.chinese: 这本书用简单的词语解释了什么是[共产主义]。

meanings.explanation: A [database] is a large collection of information that is stored in a computer so that it can be easily found, added to, or changed.

examples.english: Our school has a [database] of all the books in the library.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有一个图书馆所有书籍的[数据库]。

examples.english: The teacher looked up my name in the [database] to find my test scores.
examples.chinese: 老师在[数据库]里查了我的名字来找我的考试成绩。

examples.english: Mom added our new address to the store's [database] so they can send us packages.
examples.chinese: 妈妈把我们的新地址添加到商店的[数据库]里，这样他们就能给我们寄包裹了。

meanings.explanation: A [constellation] is a group of stars that forms a recognizable pattern in the night sky.

examples.english: On a clear dark night, I can see the [constellation] Orion with my dad.
examples.chinese: 在晴朗的黑夜，我能和爸爸一起看到猎户[星座]。

examples.english: My little sister loves drawing the [constellation] that looks like a lion.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹最喜欢画那个形状像狮子的[星座]。

examples.english: There are 88 different [constellations] recognized by scientists.
examples.chinese: 科学家一共认可了88个不同的[星座]。

meanings.explanation: A [dessert] is a sweet food that you eat after the main part of a meal.

examples.english: After dinner, we shared a yummy [dessert] together.
examples.chinese: 晚饭后，我们一起分享了一份美味的[甜点]。

examples.english: My favorite [dessert] is chocolate ice cream.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的[甜点]是巧克力冰淇淋。

examples.english: Mom made a special [dessert] for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 妈妈为我的生日做了一道特别的[甜点]。

meanings.explanation: A [democracy] is a system where people vote to choose their leaders and help make important decisions for their country.

examples.english: In a [democracy], every adult can vote for the person they want to lead the country.
examples.chinese: 在[民主]国家，每个大人都可以投票选出他们希望领导国家的人。

examples.english: We practiced [democracy] in class when we voted on the new classroom rules together.
examples.chinese: 我们全班投票制定新班规，这就是在实践[民主]。

examples.english: Many [democracies] hold elections every few years so people can choose new leaders.
examples.chinese: 许多[民主]国家每隔几年都会举行选举，让人民选出新的领导人。

meanings.explanation: A [dictatorship] is a system of government in which one person has total power and makes all the rules alone, without letting people vote or speak freely.

examples.english: In a [dictatorship], people cannot choose their own leaders.
examples.chinese: 在[独裁统治]下，人民不能自己选择领导人。

examples.english: The country was ruled by a [dictatorship] for many years.
examples.chinese: 这个国家被[独裁政权]统治了很多年。

examples.english: Many people in the story wanted to escape the [dictatorship] and live in a free country.
examples.chinese: 故事里很多人想逃离那个[独裁统治]，到自由的国家生活。

meanings.explanation: A [composer] is a person who writes music, such as songs, symphonies, or pieces for instruments.

examples.english: Mozart was a very famous [composer] when he was just a little boy.
examples.chinese: 莫扎特还是个小孩子的时候，就是一位非常著名的[作曲家]。

examples.english: My big sister wants to be a [composer] and write music for movies.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐想成为一名[作曲家]，为电影写音乐。

examples.english: The [composer] wrote a beautiful song for the school concert.
examples.chinese: 那位[作曲家]为学校音乐会写了一首优美的歌。

meanings.explanation: A [drought] is a long period of time when there is very little or no rain, making it hard for plants, animals, and people to get enough water.

examples.english: The plants in our garden died because of the [drought].
examples.chinese: 因为[干旱]，我们花园里的植物都枯死了。

examples.english: Farmers worry when a [drought] lasts for many months.
examples.chinese: 当[干旱]持续好几个月时，农民们都很担心。

examples.english: We should save water during a [drought].
examples.chinese: [干旱]期间我们应该节约用水。

meanings.explanation: An [earthquake] is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by movements deep inside the earth.

examples.english: During an [earthquake], we should hide under a strong table.
examples.chinese: [地震]的时候，我们应该躲在结实的桌子下面。

examples.english: The dog started barking before the [earthquake] happened.
examples.chinese: 那只狗在[地震]发生前就开始叫了。

examples.english: Our teacher taught us what to do if there is an [earthquake].
examples.chinese: 老师教了我们如果发生[地震]该怎么做。

meanings.explanation: [Distance learning] is a way of studying where you take classes at home using a computer or the internet, instead of going to a school building.

examples.english: Many students did [distance learning] at home last year.
examples.chinese: 去年很多学生在家上网课，进行[远程学习]。

examples.english: I like [distance learning] because I can study in my room.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢[远程学习]，因为我可以在自己的房间里学习。

examples.english: Our school offers [distance learning] for students who live far away.
examples.chinese: 我们学校为住得很远的学生提供[远程学习]。

meanings.explanation: A [diploma] is an official document you receive when you finish studying at a school, college, or university.

examples.english: My older sister just got her [diploma] from high school.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐刚拿到了她的高中[毕业证书]。

examples.english: Dad keeps his college [diploma] in a frame on the wall.
examples.chinese: 爸爸把他的大学[毕业文凭]放在墙上的相框里。

examples.english: You need to finish all your classes to get a [diploma].
examples.chinese: 你需要完成所有课程才能拿到[毕业证书]。

meanings.explanation: A [dome] is a round, curved roof that looks like the top half of a ball.

examples.english: The [dome] of that church is very big and round.
examples.chinese: 那座教堂的[圆顶]又大又圆。

examples.english: We went inside a giant glass [dome] full of colorful flowers.
examples.chinese: 我们走进一个巨大的玻璃[圆顶]，里面开满了五颜六色的花。

examples.english: The planetarium has a huge white [dome] where we watch the stars.
examples.chinese: 天文馆有一个巨大的白色[圆顶]，我们在那里看星星。

meanings.explanation: An [ecosystem] is a place where plants, animals, and nature—like water, air, and soil—all live and work together as one big team.

examples.english: A pond [ecosystem] has fish, frogs, water plants, and bugs that all need each other to live.
examples.chinese: 池塘[生态系统]里有鱼、青蛙、水草和虫子，它们互相依赖才能生存。

examples.english: Trees, birds, squirrels, and mushrooms are all part of a forest [ecosystem].
examples.chinese: 树木、鸟儿、松鼠和蘑菇都是森林[生态系统]的一部分。

examples.english: Even a small garden can be its own [ecosystem] with flowers, bees, worms, and soil.
examples.chinese: 一个小小的花园有花、蜜蜂、蚯蚓和泥土，也能自成一个[生态系统]。

meanings.explanation: The [equator] is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth that is equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole.

examples.english: It is very hot near the [equator] because the sun shines directly on it.
examples.chinese: 靠近[赤道]的地方非常热，因为太阳直射那里。

examples.english: The ship sailed across the [equator] on its way to Africa.
examples.chinese: 那艘船在去非洲的途中穿过了[赤道]。

examples.english: Countries on the [equator] have warm weather all year round.
examples.chinese: 位于[赤道]上的国家全年天气都很温暖。

synonyms: the middle line of the Earth

meanings.explanation: [Enrollment] is the act of signing up to join a school, class, or activity.

examples.english: School [enrollment] starts in September.
examples.chinese: 学校九月开始[招生]。

examples.english: I need my parents' help for summer camp [enrollment].
examples.chinese: 夏令营[报名]需要爸爸妈妈帮忙。

examples.english: The [enrollment] for the music class is now open.
examples.chinese: 音乐课的[报名]现在开始了。

meanings.explanation: A person's [ethnicity] is the group or culture they belong to, such as Chinese, Korean, or Mexican.

examples.english: My best friend and I have different [ethnicities], but we love playing together.
examples.chinese: 我最好的朋友和我[民族]不同，但我们很喜欢一起玩。

examples.english: In our class, there are students of many different [ethnicities].
examples.chinese: 我们班有很多不同[民族]的同学。

examples.english: Lily is proud of her [ethnicity] because her family has beautiful traditions.
examples.chinese: 莉莉为自己的[民族]感到骄傲，因为她的家庭有美丽的传统。

meanings.explanation: [Extinction] is what happens when a type of animal or plant completely disappears from the Earth, so there are none left anywhere.

examples.english: Many scientists are working hard to protect animals from [extinction].
examples.chinese: 许多科学家正在努力保护动物免于[灭绝]。

examples.english: The panda was once very close to [extinction], but now there are more of them.
examples.chinese: 熊猫曾经濒临[灭绝]，但现在它们的数量变多了。

examples.english: We can help prevent [extinction] by taking care of nature and the environment.
examples.chinese: 我们可以通过爱护自然环境来帮助防止[灭绝]。

meanings.explanation: [Erosion] is the gradual process by which rock or soil is worn away by natural forces like water, wind, or ice.

examples.english: Heavy rain causes [erosion] of the soil on the hillside.
examples.chinese: 大雨会造成山坡土壤的[侵蚀]。

examples.english: Wind can cause [erosion] when there are no trees to hold the soil.
examples.chinese: 没有树木固定土壤时，风力就会造成[侵蚀]。

examples.english: Over many years, [erosion] made this big cave in the rock.
examples.chinese: 经过许多年，[侵蚀]在岩石上形成了这个大洞穴。

meanings.explanation: A [delta] is an area of low, flat land shaped like a triangle where a river splits into smaller branches before flowing into the sea.

examples.english: The Nile River has a very big [delta] where it meets the sea.
examples.chinese: 尼罗河在入海口有一片非常大的[三角洲]。

examples.english: Our teacher showed us photos of the [delta] of the Pearl River.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们看了珠江[三角洲]的照片。

examples.english: Lots of people live on river [deltas] because the soil is good for growing crops.
examples.chinese: 很多人住在河流[三角洲]上，因为那里的土壤适合种庄稼。

meanings.explanation: A [firewall] is a special program that helps keep a computer safe by blocking bad things from the internet.

examples.english: My dad set up a [firewall] on our computer to keep it safe.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸在电脑上装了一个[防火墙]来保护它。

examples.english: The [firewall] stopped a bad program from getting into my tablet.
examples.chinese: [防火墙]阻止了一个坏程序进入我的平板电脑。

examples.english: Our school computers have a [firewall] so students cannot visit unsafe websites.
examples.chinese: 学校的电脑都装了[防火墙]，所以学生不能上不安全的网站。

meanings.explanation: The [facade] of a building is its front side or face, especially the part that you can see from the street.

examples.english: The [facade] of our school has a big clock on it.
examples.chinese: 我们学校大楼的[正面]有一个大钟。

examples.english: We took a photo in front of the beautiful [facade] of the museum.
examples.chinese: 我们在博物馆漂亮的[外立面]前拍了张照片。

examples.english: The old house has a white [facade] with green windows.
examples.chinese: 那栋老房子的[外墙]是白色的，配着绿色的窗户。

meanings.explanation: A [fashion designer] is someone who creates new clothes and fashionable styles.

examples.english: My cousin dreams of becoming a [fashion designer] when she grows up.
examples.chinese: 我表姐梦想长大后成为一名[服装设计师]。

examples.english: This [fashion designer] made a pretty pink dress for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 这位[服装设计师]为我的生日做了一条漂亮的粉色裙子。

examples.english: We saw a famous [fashion designer] on TV yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我们昨天在电视上见到了一位著名[服装设计师]。

meanings.explanation: A [forecast] is a smart guess or report about what the weather will be like in the future.

examples.english: The [forecast] says it will be sunny tomorrow.
examples.chinese: [天气预报]说明天是晴天。

examples.english: Mom checked the [forecast] before we went to the park.
examples.chinese: 妈妈在我们去公园之前查了[天气预报]。

examples.english: The [forecast] for this weekend shows rain, so bring your umbrella.
examples.chinese: 这个周末的[天气预报]说有雨，所以带上雨伞。

meanings.explanation: An [eclipse] is an astronomical event where one celestial body blocks light from reaching another.

examples.english: We watched a solar [eclipse] through special glasses last weekend.
examples.chinese: 我们上周末用特殊眼镜观看了一次日[食]。

examples.english: A lunar [eclipse] is easy to see with your own eyes.
examples.chinese: 月[食]用肉眼就能很清楚看到。

examples.english: The sky turned completely dark during the total [eclipse].
examples.chinese: 全[食]过程中天空完全变黑了。

meanings.explanation: A [foundation] is the strong base that something is built on, or the most important part that other things start from.

examples.english: The workers are pouring concrete for the [foundation] of the new library.
examples.chinese: 工人们正在为新图书馆浇灌混凝土[地基]。

examples.english: Learning the alphabet is the [foundation] of reading.
examples.chinese: 学习字母表是阅读的[基础]。

examples.english: Trust is the [foundation] of a good friendship.
examples.chinese: 信任是美好友谊的[基础]。

meanings.explanation: A [genre] is a particular style or type of art, music, movie, or literature that has its own special features.

examples.english: My favorite music [genre] is pop, but my brother likes rock.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的音乐[类型]是流行乐，但我哥哥喜欢摇滚。

examples.english: This library has books from every [genre], including mystery, fantasy, and history.
examples.chinese: 这个图书馆有各种[类型]的书，包括悬疑、奇幻和历史。

examples.english: What [genre] of movie do you want to watch tonight — comedy or action?
examples.chinese: 今晚你想看什么[类型]的电影——喜剧片还是动作片？

meanings.explanation: [Genetics] is the study of how parents pass traits, like eye color or height, to their children.

examples.english: In science class, we learned about [genetics] and why I have my mother's eyes.
examples.chinese: 在科学课上，我们学习了[遗传学]，知道了为什么我有妈妈的眼睛。

examples.english: [Genetics] can explain why some dogs have long fur and others have short fur.
examples.chinese: [遗传学]可以解释为什么有些狗的毛长，有些狗的毛短。

examples.english: My teacher said [genetics] is the reason I am tall like my dad.
examples.chinese: 我的老师说，我像爸爸一样高是因为[遗传学]。

meanings.explanation: A [gable] is the triangular part of a wall at the top end of a sloped roof on a house or building.

examples.english: The [gable] of my grandma's cottage is shaped like a triangle.
examples.chinese: 奶奶家小屋的[山墙]是三角形的。

examples.english: Our new house has a pretty round window in its [gable].
examples.chinese: 我们新房子的[山墙]上开了一扇漂亮的圆窗户。

examples.english: The bird built a small nest under the point of the [gable].
examples.chinese: 小鸟在[山墙]的尖顶下面搭了一个小窝。

meanings.explanation: A [galaxy] is a huge group of stars, gas, and dust in space, like the one we live in.

examples.english: We live in the Milky Way, which is one [galaxy] in the universe.
examples.chinese: 我们住在银河系中，它是宇宙中的一个[星系]。

examples.english: My brother drew a picture of a beautiful [galaxy] for his science project.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟为他的科学作业画了一幅漂亮的[星系]图。

examples.english: Scientists say there are billions of [galaxies] in the sky.
examples.chinese: 科学家说天空中有数十亿个[星系]。

meanings.explanation: [Gender] means whether someone is a boy or a girl, or a man or a woman.

examples.english: My teacher told us that everyone deserves respect no matter their [gender].
examples.chinese: 老师告诉我们，无论什么[性别]的人都应该受到尊重。

examples.english: Boys and girls of any [gender] can play together and be friends.
examples.chinese: 任何[性别]的孩子都可以一起玩、做朋友。

examples.english: In our class, we learn that [gender] does not limit what you can do.
examples.chinese: 在班上我们学到，[性别]不能限制你能做什么。

meanings.explanation: A [fossil] is the remains or mark of an animal or plant that lived a very long time ago, usually preserved in rock.

examples.english: We saw a huge dinosaur [fossil] at the museum.
examples.chinese: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙[化石]。

examples.english: Tom found a shell [fossil] on the mountain.
examples.chinese: 汤姆在山上发现了一块贝壳[化石]。

examples.english: This [fossil] of a fish is over one hundred million years old.
examples.chinese: 这块鱼[化石]已经超过一亿年了。

meanings.explanation: [Geology] is the study of the Earth — what it is made of, how it changes, and how it was formed over millions of years.

examples.english: In science class we learned about [geology] and how volcanoes are formed.
examples.chinese: 科学课上我们学了[地质学]，知道了火山是怎么形成的。

examples.english: My uncle studies [geology] and loves finding different kinds of rocks.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔研究[地质学]，他特别喜欢找各种各样的岩石。

examples.english: The [geology] book at the library has amazing pictures of diamonds and fossils.
examples.chinese: 图书馆那本[地质]书里有钻石和化石的超棒图片。

meanings.explanation: A [glacier] is a very large, slow-moving mass of ice that forms in cold places from snow that has been pressed together over many years.

examples.english: The [glacier] moves very slowly, only a few meters each year.
examples.chinese: 这条[冰川]移动得非常缓慢，一年只移动几米。

examples.english: We saw a huge blue [glacier] when we visited Alaska.
examples.chinese: 我们去阿拉斯加时看到了一条巨大的蓝色[冰川]。

examples.english: Many [glaciers] are getting smaller because the weather is getting warmer.
examples.chinese: 由于天气变暖，许多[冰川]正在变小。

meanings.explanation: When people are in [harmony] with each other, they live or work together peacefully and happily.

examples.english: My family lives in [harmony] with our neighbors.
examples.chinese: 我们一家和邻居[和睦]相处。

examples.english: The class worked in [harmony] to finish the project.
examples.chinese: 全班同学[齐心协力]完成了这个项目。

examples.english: We should protect the [harmony] of nature.
examples.chinese: 我们应该保护大自然的[和谐]。

meanings.explanation: [Ecology] is the study of how plants, animals, and people live together and affect each other in nature.

examples.english: We learned about the [ecology] of the ocean in science class.
examples.chinese: 在科学课上，我们学习了海洋的[生态]。

examples.english: My sister wants to study [ecology] in college.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐想在大学学习[生态学]。

examples.english: The teacher explained how the [ecology] of the forest is changing.
examples.chinese: 老师讲解了森林的[生态]正在怎样发生变化。

meanings.explanation: A [habitat] is the natural home of an animal or plant, where it can find food, water, and shelter to live safely.

examples.english: The forest is the [habitat] of many wild animals like bears and foxes.
examples.chinese: 森林是熊和狐狸等野生动物的[栖息地]。

examples.english: A pond is a perfect [habitat] for frogs and fish.
examples.chinese: 池塘是青蛙和鱼的绝佳[栖息地]。

examples.english: We must protect the [habitat] of bees so they can keep helping flowers grow.
examples.chinese: 我们必须保护蜜蜂的[栖息地]，这样它们才能继续帮助花儿生长。

meanings.explanation: [Hibernation] is a long, deep sleep that some animals have during the cold winter months.

examples.english: Bears eat a lot of food before [hibernation] so they can survive the winter.
examples.chinese: 熊在[冬眠]前会吃很多食物，这样才能熬过冬天。

examples.english: The hedgehog goes into [hibernation] when it gets very cold outside.
examples.chinese: 外面很冷的时候，刺猬就会进入[冬眠]。

examples.english: In spring, the frogs come out of [hibernation] and start looking for food.
examples.chinese: 春天到了，青蛙从[冬眠]中醒来，开始找吃的。

meanings.explanation: An [excavation site] is a place where people dig into the ground to uncover ancient objects or historical remains.

examples.english: My uncle took me to visit an [excavation site] near his village.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔带我去参观他村子附近的一处[发掘现场]。

examples.english: Archaeologists found a dinosaur bone at the [excavation site].
examples.chinese: 考古学家在这个[发掘现场]发现了一块恐龙骨头。

examples.english: We watched workers digging at the [excavation site] on our school trip.
examples.chinese: 我们研学旅行时看到工人在[发掘现场]挖掘。

meanings.explanation: If you talk about [globalization], you are referring to the process that makes countries all over the world more connected through trade, ideas, and culture.

examples.english: We can buy candy from Japan and chocolate from Switzerland because of [globalization].
examples.chinese: 因为[全球化]，我们能买到来自日本的糖果和瑞士的巧克力。

examples.english: [Globalization] lets us watch cartoons made in other countries on our TVs.
examples.chinese: [全球化]让我们能在电视上看到其他国家制作的动画片。

examples.english: Many kids can try tasty food from all over the world because of [globalization].
examples.chinese: 因为[全球化]，很多孩子能品尝到来自世界各地的美食。

meanings.explanation: A [geologist] is a scientist who studies the Earth, including rocks, mountains, and fossils, to understand how our planet was formed and how it changes over time.

examples.english: The [geologist] showed us many interesting rocks from the mountain.
examples.chinese: 这位[地质学家]给我们看了很多从山上找到的有趣的岩石。

examples.english: My dad wants to be a [geologist] because he loves studying volcanoes.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸想当一名[地质学家]，因为他非常喜欢研究火山。

examples.english: The [geologist] found a dinosaur fossil in the desert.
examples.chinese: 这位[地质学家]在沙漠里发现了一块恐龙化石。

meanings.explanation: [Indigenous] people or things have lived or existed naturally in a particular place since the earliest times, rather than coming from somewhere else.

examples.english: The [indigenous] people of this island have lived here for thousands of years.
examples.chinese: 这个岛上的[原住民]已经在这里生活了几千年。

examples.english: Many [indigenous] languages are in danger of disappearing.
examples.chinese: 许多[土著]语言正面临消失的危险。

examples.english: This plant is [indigenous] to Australia and grows nowhere else.
examples.chinese: 这种植物是澳大利亚[本土]的，别的地方不长。

meanings.explanation: A [language] is a system of words and signs that people use to talk, write, and understand each other.

examples.english: English is a [language] that many people around the world speak.
examples.chinese: 英语是全世界很多人说的[语言]。

examples.english: My little sister is learning a new [language] at school.
examples.chinese: 我的小妹妹正在学校学一门新[语言]。

examples.english: Dogs use body [language] to show how they feel.
examples.chinese: 狗用身体[语言]来表达它们的感受。

meanings.explanation: A [historical site] is a place that is important because of its history, and is usually preserved for people to visit and study.

examples.english: Last summer, my family visited a famous [historical site] in Xi'an.
examples.chinese: 去年夏天，我们一家去西安参观了一处有名的[历史遗迹]。

examples.english: Our teacher took us to a local [historical site] on our school trip.
examples.chinese: 我们老师在研学旅行中带我们去了一处当地的[历史遗迹]。

examples.english: Volunteers help take care of this old [historical site].
examples.chinese: 志愿者们帮忙维护这处古老的[历史遗迹]。

meanings.explanation: Your [identity] is who you are, including your name, age, and the things that make you different from others.

examples.english: He showed his [identity] card before entering the building.
examples.chinese: 他在进大楼前出示了[身份]证。

examples.english: The superhero kept his true [identity] a secret from everyone.
examples.chinese: 那位超级英雄对每个人隐瞒了自己的真实[身份]。

examples.english: A person's [identity] includes their name, age, and family.
examples.chinese: 一个人的[身份]包括他的名字、年龄和家人。

meanings.explanation: [Latitude] is the distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees on a map or globe.

examples.english: Different cities have different [latitudes] on the globe.
examples.chinese: 不同的城市在地球上有不同的[纬度]。

examples.english: We can find a place on a map by looking at its [latitude] and longitude.
examples.chinese: 我们可以通过[纬度]和经度在地图上找到一个地方。

examples.english: Canada is at a high [latitude], so it has cold winters.
examples.chinese: 加拿大位于高[纬度]，所以冬天很冷。

meanings.explanation: [Kinship] is the special feeling of closeness between family members or people who care about each other like family.

examples.english: I feel a strong [kinship] with my cousins because we grew up together.
examples.chinese: 我和堂表亲之间有一种很深的[亲近感]，因为我们是一起长大的。

examples.english: Even though we are not related by blood, there is a real [kinship] between us.
examples.chinese: 虽然我们没有血缘关系，但我们之间有一种真正的[亲情]。

examples.english: The [kinship] among teammates makes them work together like a family.
examples.chinese: 队友之间的[情谊]让他们像一家人一样齐心协力。

meanings.explanation: [Magma] is very hot, liquid rock found deep inside the Earth that can come out of a volcano.

examples.english: Deep under the ground, hot [magma] flows like a fiery river.
examples.chinese: 在地下深处，滚烫的[岩浆]像火河一样流动。

examples.english: When a volcano erupts, [magma] comes out and becomes lava.
examples.chinese: 当火山喷发时，[岩浆]涌出来变成了熔岩。

examples.english: Scientists study [magma] to learn more about what is inside our planet.
examples.chinese: 科学家研究[岩浆]来了解更多关于地球内部的秘密。

meanings.explanation: [Gravity] is the force that pulls things down toward the earth.

examples.english: The apple fell from the tree because of [gravity].
examples.chinese: 苹果从树上掉下来，是因为有[重力]。

examples.english: [Gravity] keeps our feet on the ground.
examples.chinese: [重力]让我们的双脚踩在地面上。

examples.english: There is very little [gravity] in space.
examples.chinese: 太空里的[重力]非常小。

meanings.explanation: [Humidity] is the amount of water in the air. When there is a lot of it, the air feels wet and sticky.

examples.english: The [humidity] is very high today, so my clothes feel sticky.
examples.chinese: 今天[湿度]很大，衣服黏黏的。

examples.english: Plants grow well when there is enough [humidity] in the air.
examples.chinese: 空气中有足够的[湿度]时，植物会长得很好。

examples.english: After a hot shower, the [humidity] in the bathroom goes up a lot.
examples.chinese: 洗了个热水澡后，浴室里的[湿度]升高了很多。

meanings.explanation: The [lyrics] of a song are the words that are sung in it.

examples.english: I love the [lyrics] of this song very much.
examples.chinese: 我非常喜欢这首歌的[歌词]。

examples.english: Can you help me find the [lyrics] online?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我在网上找一下[歌词]吗？

examples.english: She wrote the [lyrics] for our class song.
examples.chinese: 她为我们班的歌写了[歌词]。

meanings.explanation: [Impressionism] is a style of painting that began in France in the 1800s, in which artists use bright colors and quick brushstrokes to show the feeling of a moment rather than small details.

examples.english: In art class, we learned that [impressionism] uses lots of bright colors and outdoor light.
examples.chinese: 在美术课上，我们学到[印象派]会使用很多明亮的色彩和户外光线。

examples.english: My grandma loves [impressionism] because the paintings look soft and dreamy.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶很喜欢[印象派]，因为那些画看起来柔和又梦幻。

examples.english: The museum has a special room just for [impressionism] with paintings by Monet and Renoir.
examples.chinese: 博物馆有一个专门展示[印象派]的展厅，里面挂着莫奈和雷诺阿的画。

meanings.explanation: [Lava] is the very hot, liquid rock that comes out of a volcano when it erupts.

examples.english: The volcano shot hot [lava] high into the sky.
examples.chinese: 火山把滚烫的[熔岩]喷到了高高的天上。

examples.english: In our science book, the picture showed red [lava] flowing down the hill.
examples.chinese: 我们的科学书上画着红色的[熔岩]正往山下流。

examples.english: Scientists watch [lava] to learn more about how volcanoes work.
examples.chinese: 科学家通过观察[熔岩]来了解火山是怎么活动的。

meanings.explanation: A [masterpiece] is a piece of work, like a painting, a song, or a story, that is so good that people think it is one of the best ever made.

examples.english: This beautiful painting is a [masterpiece] by a great artist.
examples.chinese: 这幅美丽的画是一位大画家的[杰作]。

examples.english: The teacher said my story was a [masterpiece].
examples.chinese: 老师说我的作文是一篇[杰作]。

examples.english: Mozart wrote many [masterpieces] when he was very young.
examples.chinese: 莫扎特很年轻的时候就创作了许多[杰作]。

meanings.explanation: [Longitude] is a measurement of how far east or west a place is from the prime meridian, used to find positions on the Earth's surface.

examples.english: On a world map, [longitude] lines run from the North Pole to the South Pole.
examples.chinese: 在世界地图上，[经度]线从北极延伸到南极。

examples.english: The GPS in our phone uses latitude and [longitude] to find our location.
examples.chinese: 我们手机里的GPS用纬度和[经度]来确定我们的位置。

examples.english: Zero [longitude] passes through the city of Greenwich in England.
examples.chinese: 零度[经度]穿过英国的格林尼治市。

meanings.explanation: A [meteor] is a piece of rock or dust from space that burns brightly when it enters the Earth's sky, often called a shooting star.

examples.english: Last night, I saw a bright [meteor] fly across the sky.
examples.chinese: 昨晚我看到一颗明亮的[流星]划过天空。

examples.english: We went outside to watch the [meteor] shower with our family.
examples.chinese: 我们全家一起出去看[流星]雨。

examples.english: A [meteor] can look like a fast, glowing light in the dark sky.
examples.chinese: [流星]看起来就像黑暗天空中一道快速闪过的光。

meanings.explanation: A [mutation] is a change in the genes of a living thing that can make it different from others of its kind.

examples.english: A [mutation] in a flower can change its color from red to pink.
examples.chinese: 花朵的[突变]会让它的颜色从红色变成粉色。

examples.english: Some butterflies have a [mutation] that gives them brighter wings.
examples.chinese: 有些蝴蝶发生[突变]，长出了更鲜艳的翅膀。

examples.english: Scientists study how a [mutation] can help plants grow in dry places.
examples.chinese: 科学家研究[突变]如何帮助植物在干旱的地方生长。

meanings.explanation: A [melody] is a series of musical notes that sound nice together, like the part of a song you can hum or sing.

examples.english: The [melody] of this lullaby is very soft and gentle.
examples.chinese: 这首摇篮曲的[旋律]非常轻柔。

examples.english: My little sister can hum a simple [melody] on the piano.
examples.chinese: 我的小妹妹能在钢琴上哼出一段简单的[旋律]。

examples.english: The [melody] of the bird's song sounded like a happy tune.
examples.chinese: 小鸟的歌声的[旋律]听起来像一首快乐的曲子。

meanings.explanation: [Mythology] is a collection of ancient stories that a culture tells to explain the world, its gods, and its heroes.

examples.english: We learned about Greek [mythology] and the story of Zeus in class today.
examples.chinese: 今天我们课上学习了希腊[神话]和宙斯的故事。

examples.english: My grandma tells me stories from Chinese [mythology] before bed.
examples.chinese: 奶奶睡前给我讲中国[神话]里的故事。

examples.english: Many children love reading books about [mythology] from different countries.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子喜欢读不同国家的[神话]书。

meanings.explanation: A [monarchy] is a country that is ruled by a king or a queen.

examples.english: The United Kingdom is a [monarchy].
examples.chinese: 英国是一个[君主国]。

examples.english: In a [monarchy], the king or queen is the head of the country.
examples.chinese: 在[君主制]国家，国王或女王是国家的元首。

examples.english: Many [monarchies] have beautiful palaces for the royal family.
examples.chinese: 许多[君主国]为王室建有美丽的宫殿。

meanings.explanation: A [nebula] is a large cloud of gas or dust in outer space that can be seen from Earth.

examples.english: My dad showed me a photo of a glowing [nebula] in his astronomy book.
examples.chinese: 爸爸在他的天文书里给我看了一张发光[星云]的照片。

examples.english: The bright [nebula] looks like a soft, colorful cloud in space.
examples.chinese: 这片明亮的[星云]看起来像太空中一朵柔软的彩云。

examples.english: Astronomers found a new [nebula] after a big star exploded.
examples.chinese: 天文学家在一颗大恒星爆炸后发现了一块新[星云]。

meanings.explanation: A [mineral] is a naturally occurring solid substance found in rocks and the earth, which is not formed from plants or animals.

examples.english: This rock has a shiny yellow [mineral] inside it.
examples.chinese: 这块岩石里面有一块发亮的黄色[矿物]。

examples.english: Our body needs this [mineral] to stay healthy.
examples.chinese: 我们的身体需要这种[矿物质]来保持健康。

examples.english: Miners dig [mineral] out of the ground to use in factories.
examples.chinese: 矿工从地下挖出[矿物]，供工厂使用。

meanings.explanation: An [organism] is any living thing, such as an animal, a plant, a fungus, or a very tiny creature that can only be seen through a microscope.

examples.english: A fish is a living [organism] that lives in water.
examples.chinese: 鱼是生活在水中的[生物体]。

examples.english: There are tiny [organisms] in the soil that help plants grow.
examples.chinese: 土壤里有微小的[生物]，它们帮助植物生长。

examples.english: A dog is a complex [organism] with many different body parts.
examples.chinese: 狗是一种复杂的[生物体]，有许许多多不同的身体部位。

meanings.explanation: An [instrument] is a tool or device used for a particular practical or scientific purpose.

examples.english: A thermometer is a special [instrument] that tells us how hot or cold it is.
examples.chinese: 温度计是一种能告诉我们温度的特殊[仪器]。

examples.english: The dentist uses clean [instruments] when he checks my teeth.
examples.chinese: 牙医检查我的牙齿时会使用干净的[器械]。

examples.english: My dad uses a special [instrument] to fix our broken bike.
examples.chinese: 爸爸用一种特殊[工具]修理我们坏掉的自行车。

meanings.explanation: A [peninsula] is a piece of land that has water on three sides and is connected to a larger land area on one side.

examples.english: We drove to a small [peninsula] and had a picnic by the sea.
examples.chinese: 我们开车去了一个小[半岛]，在海边野餐。

examples.english: My uncle lives on a [peninsula] with beaches on both sides.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔住在一个[半岛]上，两边都是沙滩。

examples.english: The map shows a long [peninsula] stretching into the ocean.
examples.chinese: 地图上显示一个长长的[半岛]伸入大海。

meanings.explanation: An [omnivore] is an animal that eats both plants and meat.

examples.english: Pigs are [omnivores] because they eat both plants and meat.
examples.chinese: 猪是[杂食动物]，因为它们既吃植物又吃肉。

examples.english: Bears are [omnivores] — they love berries and fish.
examples.chinese: 熊是[杂食动物]，它们喜欢浆果和鱼。

examples.english: People are [omnivores] too, since we eat vegetables and meat.
examples.chinese: 人也是[杂食动物]，因为我们既吃蔬菜又吃肉。

meanings.explanation: A [mammal] is an animal that gives birth to live babies and feeds its young with milk from the mother's body.

examples.english: A dog is a common [mammal] that lives with people.
examples.chinese: 狗是一种和人类同住的常见[哺乳动物]。

examples.english: A blue whale is the largest [mammal] on Earth.
examples.chinese: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的[哺乳动物]。

examples.english: Kangaroos are [mammals] that carry their babies in a special pouch.
examples.chinese: 袋鼠是会把宝宝放在特殊育儿袋里的[哺乳动物]。

meanings.explanation: [Phishing] is a dishonest way of tricking people online to steal their personal information, like passwords or bank details, by pretending to be someone they can trust.

examples.english: I got a [phishing] email that looked like it was from my school.
examples.chinese: 我收到了一封看起来像学校发来的[钓鱼]邮件。

examples.english: My mom told me never to click on links in a [phishing] message.
examples.chinese: 妈妈告诉我千万不要点击[钓鱼]信息里的链接。

examples.english: The teacher showed us how to spot a [phishing] website.
examples.chinese: 老师教我们怎么识别[钓鱼]网站。

meanings.explanation: Your [metabolism] is how your body turns the food you eat into energy to help you grow, move, and play.

examples.english: Eating breakfast helps my [metabolism] work well all day.
examples.chinese: 吃早餐能帮我的[新陈代谢]一整天都好好运作。

examples.english: Running and playing sports can speed up your [metabolism].
examples.chinese: 跑步和做运动可以加快你的[新陈代谢]。

examples.english: Some people have a fast [metabolism], so they burn calories quickly.
examples.chinese: 有些人的[新陈代谢]很快，所以他们消耗热量也很快。

meanings.explanation: [Photosynthesis] is the process by which green plants use sunlight to make food from water and carbon dioxide.

examples.english: Trees use [photosynthesis] to make their own food.
examples.chinese: 树木通过[光合作用]制造自己的食物。

examples.english: We learned about [photosynthesis] in science class today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在科学课上学习了[光合作用]。

examples.english: Without sunlight, [photosynthesis] cannot happen.
examples.chinese: 没有阳光，[光合作用]就无法进行。

meanings.explanation: An [orbit] is the curved path that a planet, moon, or spacecraft follows around another object in space.

examples.english: The Moon stays in [orbit] around the Earth.
examples.chinese: 月球一直绕着地球转，这就是它的[轨道]。

examples.english: The satellite travels in an [orbit] high above our planet.
examples.chinese: 卫星在我们星球上空很高的[轨道]上运行。

examples.english: The rocket put the telescope into [orbit] around the Sun.
examples.chinese: 火箭把望远镜送入了绕太阳的[轨道]。

meanings.explanation: A [planet] is a very large, round object in space that moves around a star, such as the Sun.

examples.english: Earth is the [planet] where we live.
examples.chinese: 地球是我们居住的[行星]。

examples.english: There are eight [planets] in our solar system.
examples.chinese: 我们的太阳系里有八颗[行星]。

examples.english: Jupiter is the biggest [planet] in the sky.
examples.chinese: 木星是天空中最大的[行星]。

meanings.explanation: A [plateau] is a large flat area of land that is higher than the land around it.

examples.english: The cows are eating grass on the [plateau].
examples.chinese: 牛群正在[高原]上吃草。

examples.english: We climbed to the top of the [plateau] and saw the whole valley.
examples.chinese: 我们爬到了[高原]顶上，看到了整个山谷。

examples.english: It is very cold on the high [plateau] in winter.
examples.chinese: 冬天高[原]上非常冷。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [prehistoric] belongs to the very old time before people started writing down history.

examples.english: In [prehistoric] times, people lived in caves and hunted wild animals.
examples.chinese: 在[史前]时期，人们住在洞穴里，猎捕野生动物。

examples.english: Dinosaurs were [prehistoric] animals that lived millions of years ago.
examples.chinese: 恐龙是生活在数百万年前的[史前]动物。

examples.english: Scientists found [prehistoric] paintings on the wall of a deep cave.
examples.chinese: 科学家在一个深洞的墙壁上发现了[史前]画作。

meanings.explanation: [Prey] is an animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal.

examples.english: A mouse is common [prey] for a cat.
examples.chinese: 老鼠是猫常见的[猎物]。

examples.english: The lion quietly watched its [prey] from behind the grass.
examples.chinese: 狮子在草丛后面静静地盯着它的[猎物]。

examples.english: Small fish are the main [prey] of these big birds.
examples.chinese: 小鱼是这些大鸟的主要[猎物]。

meanings.explanation: A [referee] is a person who is in charge of a game or sport and makes sure that all the players follow the rules.

examples.english: The [referee] blew the whistle to start the soccer game.
examples.chinese: [裁判]吹响了哨子，足球比赛开始了。

examples.english: Our teacher is the [referee] for today's basketball match.
examples.chinese: 我们老师是今天篮球赛的[裁判]。

examples.english: The player was angry because the [referee] said the ball was out.
examples.chinese: 那个球员很生气，因为[裁判]说球出界了。

meanings.explanation: A [religion] is a set of beliefs about God or gods, and the ways people show their faith through prayer, worship, and special ceremonies.

examples.english: Many people around the world follow a [religion] that teaches them to be kind.
examples.chinese: 世界上很多人信仰[宗教]，教导他们要友善待人。

examples.english: My friend's [religion] tells her to help people in need.
examples.chinese: 我朋友的[宗教]告诉她要帮助有困难的人。

examples.english: In school we learn about different kinds of [religion] from around the world.
examples.chinese: 在学校我们了解世界各地不同的[宗教]。

meanings.explanation: A [philosophy] is a set of beliefs that someone uses to guide how they live and make decisions.

examples.english: My dad's [philosophy] is that it's always better to tell the truth.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸的[人生哲学]是，说实话永远更好。

examples.english: Our class has a [philosophy] of helping each other every day.
examples.chinese: 我们班有一套互相帮助的[理念]。

examples.english: My favorite [philosophy] is to treat others how you want to be treated.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的[人生准则]是：你希望别人怎么对你，你就怎么对别人。

meanings.explanation: [Reproduction] is the process by which living things produce young or create new individuals of the same kind, such as when animals have babies or flowers make seeds to grow new flowers.

examples.english: The mother bird lays eggs for [reproduction].
examples.chinese: 鸟妈妈下蛋是为了[繁殖]。

examples.english: In science class, we learned about how [reproduction] works in fish.
examples.chinese: 在科学课上，我们学到了鱼是如何进行[繁殖]的。

examples.english: Plants use flowers and seeds for [reproduction].
examples.chinese: 植物通过花朵和种子来[繁殖]。

common_collocations: keep a reptile as a pet

meanings.explanation: A [reptile] is an animal with cold blood and skin covered in scales or hard plates. Reptiles lay eggs and include snakes, lizards, turtles, and crocodiles.

examples.english: A turtle is a [reptile] that carries a hard shell on its back.
examples.chinese: 乌龟是一种背上背着硬壳的[爬行动物]。

examples.english: My little brother is not afraid of snakes or other [reptiles].
examples.chinese: 我弟弟不怕蛇之类的[爬行动物]。

examples.english: We saw many [reptiles] at the zoo, including lizards and crocodiles.
examples.chinese: 我们在动物园看到了很多[爬行动物]，包括蜥蜴和鳄鱼。

meanings.explanation: [Pottery] is the name for bowls, cups, vases, and other objects made from clay that has been baked in a very hot oven.

examples.english: My mom made a beautiful [pottery] bowl for our kitchen.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈为厨房做了一个漂亮的[陶器]碗。

examples.english: We painted [pottery] in art class today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在美术课上给[陶器]上了色。

examples.english: There is a [pottery] shop near my school.
examples.chinese: 我们学校附近有一家[陶器]店。

meanings.explanation: A [recipe] is a set of instructions that tells you how to cook a particular food or dish.

examples.english: My mom wrote down her secret chocolate cookie [recipe].
examples.chinese: 我妈妈记下了她秘制巧克力曲奇的[食谱]。

examples.english: I followed the [recipe] to make tomato soup for dinner.
examples.chinese: 我照着[食谱]做了西红柿汤当晚餐。

examples.english: Grandma has a handwritten [recipe] for apple pie from her mother.
examples.chinese: 奶奶有一份她母亲手写的苹果派[食谱]。

meanings.explanation: A [portrait] is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person that usually shows their face and upper body.

examples.english: My grandma has a [portrait] of my grandpa hanging on her bedroom wall.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶卧室的墙上挂着一幅我爷爷的[肖像]。

examples.english: The art teacher asked us to draw a [portrait] of our favorite family member.
examples.chinese: 美术老师让我们画一幅自己最喜欢的家庭成员的[肖像]。

examples.english: The museum has many old [portraits] of kings and queens from hundreds of years ago.
examples.chinese: 这家博物馆藏有许多数百年前国王和王后的古老[肖像]。

meanings.explanation: A [revolution] is a very big change in the way people live, work, or think.

examples.english: The invention of the telephone caused a [revolution] in how people talk to each other.
examples.chinese: 电话的发明让人们交流的方式发生了[巨变]。

examples.english: The Industrial [Revolution] changed the way people made things in factories.
examples.chinese: 工业[革命]改变了人们在工厂里制造东西的方式。

examples.english: Smart phones have brought a [revolution] to our daily lives.
examples.chinese: 智能手机给我们的日常生活带来了[变革]。

meanings.explanation: A [rhythm] is a regular, repeated pattern of sounds or movements in music, dancing, or nature.

examples.english: I love the fast [rhythm] of this song — it makes me want to dance.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢这首歌的快[节奏]，让我忍不住想跳舞。

examples.english: The drummer kept a strong [rhythm] while everyone clapped along.
examples.chinese: 鼓手打着有力的[节拍]，大家一起跟着拍手。

examples.english: My music teacher said I have a good sense of [rhythm].
examples.chinese: 我的音乐老师说我的[节奏感]很好。

meanings.explanation: [Precipitation] is water that falls from clouds in the sky, such as rain, snow, sleet, or hail.

examples.english: We had a lot of [precipitation] this spring, so the flowers are blooming beautifully.
examples.chinese: 今年春天[降水]很多，所以花儿开得很美。

examples.english: The weather report says there will be [precipitation] tonight, so bring an umbrella.
examples.chinese: 天气预报说今晚会有[降水]，记得带上雨伞。

examples.english: Scientists study [precipitation] to understand the weather better.
examples.chinese: 科学家研究[降水]来了解天气。

meanings.explanation: A [scholarship] is money given to a student to help pay for their school or college fees.

examples.english: She won a [scholarship] to study at a famous university.
examples.chinese: 她获得了[奖学金]，可以去一所著名大学读书。

examples.english: I am going to apply for a [scholarship] to help my parents pay for school.
examples.chinese: 我打算申请[奖学金]，帮爸妈减轻学费负担。

examples.english: He got a sports [scholarship] because he is very good at basketball.
examples.chinese: 他因为篮球打得特别好，拿到了一笔体育[奖学金]。

meanings.explanation: A [ritual] is a set of actions that are always done in the same fixed way, for religious, cultural, or personal reasons.

examples.english: Our family has a special [ritual] before eating on Lunar New Year's Eve.
examples.chinese: 我们家在除夕夜吃饭前有一个特别[仪式]。

examples.english: I have a morning [ritual] of drinking warm water before breakfast.
examples.chinese: 我早餐前有喝温水的晨间[惯例]。

examples.english: The church holds a traditional [ritual] every Easter.
examples.chinese: 教堂每年复活节都会举办一场传统[仪式]。

common_collocations: revolutionize the way we do things

meanings.explanation: To [revolutionize] something means to change it completely and make it much better or more modern.

examples.english: The washing machine [revolutionized] how we wash our clothes.
examples.chinese: 洗衣机[彻底改变了]我们洗衣服的方式。

examples.english: Smartphones have [revolutionized] how people take pictures.
examples.chinese: 智能手机[彻底改变了]人们拍照的方式。

examples.english: The bicycle [revolutionized] the way people travel around.
examples.chinese: 自行车[彻底改变了]人们出行的方式。

meanings.explanation: [Respiration] is the process by which all living things take in oxygen and give out carbon dioxide to get energy needed to live and grow.

examples.english: All living plants and animals need [respiration] to stay alive.
examples.chinese: 所有活的动植物都需要[呼吸作用]才能存活。

examples.english: Our science teacher taught us about [respiration] in class this week.
examples.chinese: 我们的科学老师这周在课上给我们讲了[呼吸作用]。

examples.english: When you run fast, your body needs more energy so your [respiration] speeds up.
examples.chinese: 你快跑的时候，身体需要更多能量，所以你的[呼吸]会加快。

meanings.explanation: A [router] is a small electronic device that helps your computer, phone, or tablet connect to the internet.

examples.english: Our [router] is on the desk in the living room.
examples.chinese: 我们的[路由器]放在客厅的书桌上。

examples.english: I can't watch my favorite cartoon because the [router] is broken.
examples.chinese: 我没法看最喜欢的动画片，因为[路由器]坏了。

examples.english: My dad bought a new [router] so the Wi-Fi is much faster now.
examples.chinese: 爸爸买了一个新的[路由器]，现在Wi-Fi快多了。

meanings.explanation: [Sediment] is the tiny bits of dirt, sand, or rock that sink to the bottom of water or another liquid.

examples.english: After the storm, [sediment] settled at the bottom of the pond.
examples.chinese: 暴风雨过后，池塘底部积了一层[沉淀物]。

examples.english: The fish tank has a layer of [sediment] on the bottom.
examples.chinese: 鱼缸底部有一层[沉淀物]。

examples.english: We can see [sediment] in the river after heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 大雨过后，我们可以看见河里有[泥沙]。

meanings.explanation: [Ruins] are what is left of old buildings or cities after they have fallen down or been destroyed over a very long time.

examples.english: The old castle next to our school is now in [ruins].
examples.chinese: 我们学校旁边那座古老的城堡如今已成[废墟]。

examples.english: We saw the [ruins] of an old temple during our trip.
examples.chinese: 我们在旅行中看到了一座古庙的[废墟]。

examples.english: At the museum, we visited the [ruins] of ancient houses.
examples.chinese: 在博物馆里，我们参观了古代房屋的[废墟]。

meanings.explanation: A [sculpture] is a work of art that is made by shaping materials like clay, stone, or wood.

examples.english: We made a small clay [sculpture] of a cat in art class.
examples.chinese: 我们在美术课上做了一个小猫的小型黏土[雕塑]。

examples.english: There is a big stone [sculpture] in the city park.
examples.chinese: 城市公园里有一座大大的石头[雕塑]。

examples.english: My uncle carved a wooden [sculpture] of a rabbit for me.
examples.chinese: 叔叔给我雕了一个兔子造型的木制[雕塑]。

meanings.explanation: A [satellite] is a machine that is sent into space and travels around the Earth or another planet, used to send signals, study the weather, or take pictures.

examples.english: A weather [satellite] helps us know when a storm is coming.
examples.chinese: 气象[卫星]可以帮助我们预测暴风雨什么时候到来。

examples.english: Our television gets its signal from a [satellite] in space.
examples.chinese: 我们家的电视信号是太空中一颗[卫星]传来的。

examples.english: Scientists sent a [satellite] into space to study the Earth.
examples.chinese: 科学家向太空发射了一颗[卫星]来研究地球。

meanings.explanation: A [seminar] is a small class where students talk and share ideas to learn about a subject.

examples.english: Our class had a [seminar] about how to keep the school clean.
examples.chinese: 我们班举办了一个关于保持校园清洁的[研讨会]。

examples.english: I shared my book report at the [seminar].
examples.chinese: 我在[研讨会]上分享了我的读书报告。

examples.english: The [seminar] on planting trees was very interesting.
examples.chinese: 那个关于种树的[研讨会]非常有趣。

meanings.explanation: A [sketch] is a simple, quick drawing that is not very detailed.

examples.english: I drew a [sketch] of my cat sleeping on the sofa.
examples.chinese: 我画了一张我的猫在沙发上睡觉的[草图]。

examples.english: The artist made a quick [sketch] of the trees in the park.
examples.chinese: 那位艺术家在公园里快速画了一张树木的[速写]。

examples.english: Before painting, the teacher asked us to do a [sketch] first.
examples.chinese: 画画之前，老师让我们先画一张[草图]。

meanings.explanation: [Seasoning] is salt, pepper, herbs, or spices that you add to food to make it taste better.

examples.english: My mom adds a little [seasoning] when she cooks chicken.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈做鸡肉时会加一点[调料]。

examples.english: This soup needs more [seasoning] because it tastes plain.
examples.chinese: 这碗汤有点淡，需要多加些[调料]。

examples.english: Grandma put some special [seasoning] in the dumplings.
examples.chinese: 奶奶在饺子里放了一些特别的[调料]。

meanings.explanation: A [supernova] is a powerful explosion of a star that happens when the star reaches the end of its life.

examples.english: Scientists used a telescope to watch a [supernova] in the night sky.
examples.chinese: 科学家用望远镜观察夜空中的一颗[超新星]。

examples.english: A [supernova] can shine brighter than a whole galaxy for a short time.
examples.chinese: [超新星]能在短时间内比整个星系还要亮。

examples.english: My teacher showed us a video of a [supernova] happening far away in space.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们看了一段遥远太空中[超新星]爆发的视频。

meanings.explanation: A country's [sovereignty] is its right and power to rule itself without being controlled by other countries.

examples.english: Every country has its own [sovereignty] and can decide how to run itself.
examples.chinese: 每个国家都有自己的[主权]，可以自己决定怎么管理国家。

examples.english: The small country protected its [sovereignty] so it could stay free.
examples.chinese: 这个小国家保护了自己的[主权]，这样才能保持自由。

examples.english: Learning about a country's [sovereignty] helps us understand how it works.
examples.chinese: 了解一个国家的[主权]，能帮我们明白这个国家是怎么运作的。

meanings.explanation: A [sommelier] is a person who works in a restaurant and knows a lot about wine. They help guests choose the best wine to go with their food.

examples.english: The [sommelier] helped my parents pick a nice red wine for dinner.
examples.chinese: [侍酒师]帮我爸妈选了一款很不错的红酒配晚餐。

examples.english: My cousin is studying to become a [sommelier] at a big hotel.
examples.chinese: 我表哥正在一家大酒店学习，想成为一名[侍酒师]。

examples.english: The [sommelier] at that French restaurant knows more than two hundred kinds of wine.
examples.chinese: 那家法国餐厅的[侍酒师]认识两百多种葡萄酒。

meanings.explanation: If something is [tectonic], it relates to the large moving pieces of the Earth's surface called plates.

examples.english: Earthquakes happen when [tectonic] plates move and bump into each other.
examples.chinese: 当地球上的[板块]移动并相互碰撞时，就会发生地震。

examples.english: The teacher showed us a map of all the [tectonic] plates under the oceans.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们看了一张海底所有[板块]的地图。

examples.english: Volcanoes often form near the edges of [tectonic] plates.
examples.chinese: 火山常常在[板块]边缘附近形成。

meanings.explanation: A [skyscraper] is a very tall modern building in a large city.

examples.english: I saw a huge [skyscraper] when I visited Hong Kong.
examples.chinese: 我去香港的时候看到了一栋巨大的[摩天大楼]。

examples.english: This [skyscraper] is one of the tallest buildings in the country.
examples.chinese: 这栋[摩天大楼]是全国最高的建筑之一。

examples.english: My mom works in an office inside a [skyscraper] downtown.
examples.chinese: 妈妈在市中心的一栋[摩天大楼]里的办公室上班。

common_collocations: point a telescope at the stars

meanings.explanation: A [telescope] is a tool that makes faraway things look closer, so you can see the moon, stars, and planets more clearly.

examples.english: I used my [telescope] to look at the moon tonight.
examples.chinese: 我今晚用[望远镜]看月亮。

examples.english: My dad bought me a small [telescope] for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 爸爸给我买了一个小[望远镜]当生日礼物。

examples.english: You can see the stars very clearly with a [telescope].
examples.chinese: 用[望远镜]可以很清楚地看到星星。

meanings.explanation: A [thesis] is a very long and serious piece of writing that someone does for a university degree, showing what they have learned or discovered about a topic.

examples.english: My big sister is writing a [thesis] about how plants grow in different kinds of soil.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐正在写一篇关于不同土壤中植物如何生长的[论文]。

examples.english: It took Dad two years to finish his [thesis] on the history of the Great Wall.
examples.chinese: 爸爸花了两年时间才完成他那篇关于长城历史的[论文]。

examples.english: Before you start your [thesis], you need to choose a good topic that you really like.
examples.chinese: 开始写[论文]之前，你得先选一个自己真正喜欢的好题目。

meanings.explanation: The [topography] of an area is the shape of its land, including its hills, valleys, rivers, and mountains.

examples.english: The [topography] of our town has many small hills and a big river.
examples.chinese: 我们镇的[地形]有很多小山丘和一条大河。

examples.english: My class is learning about the [topography] of the desert.
examples.chinese: 我们班正在学习沙漠的[地形]。

examples.english: The [topography] of this island is mostly flat with some mountains in the middle.
examples.chinese: 这座岛屿的[地形]大部分是平的，中间有一些山。

meanings.explanation: [Tectonic plates] are large, rigid pieces of rock that make up the outer layer of the Earth's surface, and they move very slowly over time.

examples.english: Scientists study how [tectonic plates] move under the ground.
examples.chinese: 科学家研究[构造板块]在地下的运动。

examples.english: Earthquakes often happen where [tectonic plates] meet.
examples.chinese: 地震常发生在[构造板块]交汇的地方。

examples.english: Our geography teacher showed us a picture of [tectonic plates] today.
examples.chinese: 今天地理老师给我们看了一张[构造板块]的图片。

meanings.explanation: A [tornado] is a very strong, fast-spinning wind that looks like a dark funnel-shaped cloud reaching from the sky to the ground.

examples.english: The weather report says a [tornado] may form this afternoon, so we should stay inside.
examples.chinese: 天气预报说今天下午可能会有[龙卷风]，所以我们得待在屋里。

examples.english: When a [tornado] comes, it is important to go to a safe place like a basement.
examples.chinese: [龙卷风]来的时候，去地下室这样的安全地方很重要。

examples.english: The strong winds of a [tornado] can spin faster than a race car.
examples.chinese: [龙卷风]的强风转得比赛车还快。

meanings.explanation: A [thunderstorm] is a storm with thunder and lightning, and usually heavy rain.

examples.english: We stayed inside when the big [thunderstorm] came.
examples.chinese: 大[雷暴]来的时候我们待在屋里。

examples.english: A summer [thunderstorm] often cools down the hot air.
examples.chinese: 夏日[雷暴]通常会让炎热的空气变得凉爽。

examples.english: My little dog hides under my bed during a [thunderstorm].
examples.chinese: 我的小狗在[雷暴]期间会躲在我的床底下。

meanings.explanation: A [tournament] is a contest where many players or teams play a series of games to find the best one.

examples.english: Our school held a fun soccer [tournament] last month.
examples.chinese: 我们学校上个月举办了一场有趣的足球[比赛]。

examples.english: She practiced every day and won the spelling [tournament].
examples.chinese: 她每天练习，赢得了拼写[大赛]。

examples.english: Eight teams joined the weekend basketball [tournament].
examples.chinese: 八支队伍参加了周末的篮球[锦标赛]。

meanings.explanation: A [tradition] is a special thing that people in a family or group have done the same way for a very long time.

examples.english: It is a family [tradition] to have dumplings on New Year's Eve.
examples.chinese: 除夕吃饺子是我们家的[传统]。

examples.english: My school has a [tradition] of singing together every Friday morning.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有一个[传统]，每周五早上一起唱歌。

examples.english: Making mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival is an old Chinese [tradition].
examples.chinese: 中秋节做月饼是中国古老的[传统]。

meanings.explanation: A [turret] is a small tower that sticks out from the wall of a castle or building, often at a corner.

examples.english: The princess looked out from the castle [turret].
examples.chinese: 公主从城堡的[塔楼]上向外眺望。

examples.english: There is a round [turret] at each corner of the old building.
examples.chinese: 那座老建筑的每个角落都有一座圆形[塔楼]。

examples.english: We climbed the narrow stairs inside the stone [turret].
examples.chinese: 我们沿着石头[塔楼]里狭窄的楼梯爬了上去。

meanings.explanation: A [typhoon] is a very strong and dangerous storm with heavy rain and powerful winds that happens in the western Pacific Ocean.

examples.english: The [typhoon] blew down many trees on our street.
examples.chinese: [台风]把我们街上的好多树都吹倒了。

examples.english: We stayed at home because a [typhoon] was coming.
examples.chinese: 因为[台风]要来了，我们都待在家里。

examples.english: The school closed for two days because of the [typhoon].
examples.chinese: 因为[台风]，学校停课了两天。

meanings.explanation: [Zoology] is the scientific study of animals and how they live, grow, and behave.

examples.english: In our [zoology] class, we learned about lions, elephants, and dolphins.
examples.chinese: 在[动物学]课上，我们学习了狮子、大象和海豚的知识。

examples.english: My sister loves animals so much that she wants to study [zoology] in college.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐非常喜欢动物，她想上大学学习[动物学]。

examples.english: The zoo works with scientists who know a lot about [zoology].
examples.chinese: 动物园和精通[动物学]的科学家们一起合作。

meanings.explanation: [Tuition] is the money that you pay to receive teaching, especially at a college, university, or for private classes.

examples.english: My parents pay [tuition] for my weekly piano lessons.
examples.chinese: 我父母为我每周的钢琴课支付[学费]。

examples.english: My older brother works part-time to pay his college [tuition].
examples.chinese: 我哥哥做兼职来支付他的大学[学费]。

examples.english: A kind neighbor helped pay [tuition] for the poor girl.
examples.chinese: 一位善良的邻居帮这个贫穷的女孩支付[学费]。

meanings.explanation: A [war] is a period of fighting between countries or large groups of people.

examples.english: My great-grandpa was a soldier in the [war].
examples.chinese: 我的曾祖父是一名参加过那场[战争]的士兵。

examples.english: People all over the world hope there will be no more [war].
examples.chinese: 全世界的人们都希望不再有[战争]。

examples.english: Many families lost their homes because of the [war].
examples.chinese: 许多家庭因为这场[战争]失去了家园。

meanings.explanation: A [tempo] is the speed at which a piece of music is played.

examples.english: This song has a fast [tempo] that makes me want to dance.
examples.chinese: 这首歌的[节奏]很快，让我忍不住想跳舞。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to play the music at a slower [tempo].
examples.chinese: 老师让我们把音乐的[速度]放慢一点来弹。

examples.english: I can hear that the [tempo] of this song changes from slow to fast.
examples.chinese: 我能听出来这首歌的[节奏]从慢变快了。

meanings.explanation: A [watercolor] is a type of paint that you mix with water to make colorful pictures.

examples.english: I love painting flowers with [watercolors] after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后我喜欢用[水彩]画花。

examples.english: My mom bought me a new [watercolor] set for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 妈妈给我买了一盒新的[水彩]作为生日礼物。

examples.english: This beautiful picture of a cat was made with [watercolor].
examples.chinese: 这幅漂亮的猫的画是用[水彩]画的。

meanings.explanation: A [theater] is a building or place where people go to watch plays, movies, or other performances.

examples.english: Our class went to the [theater] to watch a fun play about animals.
examples.chinese: 我们全班去[剧院]看了一部关于动物的有趣话剧。

examples.english: Mom took me to the [theater] to see a cartoon movie on Saturday.
examples.chinese: 妈妈周六带我去[电影院]看了一场动画片。

examples.english: The [theater] was very quiet when the show started.
examples.chinese: 演出开始时，[剧院]里非常安静。
